title: pairs/{pairId}/countdowns/{id} (shared calendar event)
description: A shared calendar event; countdowns are events with showAsCountdown (missing = true for events made before the calendar). Written by the app. dateKey (local yyyy-mm-dd) is what the reminder job uses; lastReminded* are function-written.

hasTime.description: True when date carries a time of day; reminders then use nextRemindAt.

nextRemindAt.description: Next notification instant; written by the app, advanced by countdownTimedReminders.

endDate.description: Last day of a multi-day event.

isVirtual.description: Dates: online rather than in person.

ratings.description: Dates: uid -> hearts; each member writes only their own.
